Episode 120. Why is it Hairan? (1)
Sword energy was pushing away the thunder.
It was Ron's sword energy. Every time he swung Rashid, a wave of sword energy shot up into the sky.
Even the thunder that seemed to cover the whole Sword Emperor Castle looked like a child's play in front of Ron's sword energy.
'How many people in the world can protect a castle like this by spreading sword energy like an umbrella?'
The question came to Jin's mind as soon as he saw the scene. It was a domain only possible for 10-star knights, who were among the best.
What was even more surprising was that Ron didn't tire at all while constantly spreading such sword energy.
"Knight Ron!"
As Jin shouted, Ron turned his head. After checking Veradin, who was tied to Shuri while unconscious, he nodded vigorously towards Jin.
You did well!
That was the expression on his face. Although Veradin was not completely unharmed, Jin's rescue allowed them to bear less of the enemy's scheme.
Meanwhile, Lata, who was still fighting against demons and bio-golems at the front line, felt a strange emotion when he saw Jin return.
It was a kind of admiration.
It was a feeling he hadn't experienced in a long time.
Jin fought against him, overcame the duel with ease, assessed the situation as soon as an unexpected terror began, found the core alone, and brought Veradin.
Regardless of their relationship with Jin, there was no reason not to admire him. Even Ron didn't realize that Veradin was the core.
'He's amazing. I never thought I'd (humanly) fall for a man.'
Shuri landed next to Ron, stomping on the giant demons.
"I don't know why I forgot about him. Was the injury serious?"
"There's no harm to his life."
"Alright. Give him proper compensation after the situation has passed. As for those ice blocks... I see."
Until now, Ron had only sliced the magicians to almost dust when they regenerated.
He had not used 'sealing' at all. It was because he didn't have a magical mindset, and all the magicians inside the castle were without their magic energy.
Moreover, since Ron didn't tire at all while spreading such enormous sword energy, there was no need to look for other means.
"Magicians in the castle, come in! Seal the golems that use lightning!"
As Ron gave the order, the knights behind him swiftly made way. The magicians escaped through the gap and began casting the power of ice.
'But it's strange. Why isn't the thunder subsiding?'
Even though the magicians appeared and ice blocks sealing the Myeongin's bodies were rising here and there, the pouring thunder from the sky showed no sign of subsiding.
'Is there another Myeongin? Ron's sword energy is so incredible that it's hidden, but it's a lightning that can't be achieved by just a few Myeongin. I didn't think about it because I was rushing.'
At least more than 500 Myeongin.
Or something other than Myeongin. Otherwise, it was an inexplicable thunder.
At a glance, it seemed that all six Myeongin who attacked the Sword Emperor Castle had been sealed.
However, the lightning was getting stronger, and now it was certain. There was something else.
Ron had the same thought as Jin.
"It feels completely different from the ones trapped in the ice seal..."
Ron's eyes narrowed as he looked up at the sky.
The sky was a chaotic mix of colors, with energy, sword energy, and thunder.
"I have to see what it is."
Ron withdrew the sword energy he had been emitting. Thunder poured down as if a dam had burst, but it was much weaker than before.
And suddenly.
The sky was 'opening.'
What was revealed looked like the bottom of a ship.
'What is that...?'
As far as everyone here, including Jin, knew, there was only one ship floating in the sky in the world.
Kojeck, Zefl's airborne war machine.
However, what emerged from the dark clouds was not Kojeck. It was a completely different flying ship, only similar in shape.
"... Seeing the flying ship, I start to think that they might really be Octavia's subordinates."
Ron shrugged his shoulders with a sarcastic laugh.
"It's probably Kinzelo, not Zefl, Knight Ron."
"That's right. But do you really think they have nothing to do with it?"
Jin shook his head.

"At this point, I don't think Zefl is completely unrelated to this terror. Even if they didn't directly sponsor it, it would be a situation that benefits them, so there would be some tacit part after the incident."
"Despicable guys."
Fizzle, fizzle...!

Dark clouds containing lightning were gathering near the ship. The ship seemed to have a much more complex structure than Kojeck on the outside, and the protrusions on various parts of the hull seemed to gather magical power and form dark clouds.
As the ship appeared, the battlefield became silent for a moment.
The crazy demons stopped moving, and the soldiers caught their breath and stared at the ship with blank eyes.
Most of them were instinctively intimidated. It was natural that the giant demons, bio-golems, Myeongin, and now even a flying ship had appeared from the ground.
Jin turned his head and met eyes with Murakan and Quikantel. The two dragons seemed to have no reaction, as if they were seeing the ship for the first time.
Ron was the only one without any hesitation.
"Reveal your name, uninvited guest."
It was a voice filled with a majestic aura. Despite speaking it casually, Ron's voice resonated powerfully, reaching the ship.
Soon, familiar faces appeared at the front of the ship.

"If I were to introduce this person, he's Belakt Sidriker! A great warrior of the Baekrang tribe, the chieftain of the Sidriker clan, the master of the Loskal plains, and the ruler of the Antomek mountain range..."
The person introducing Belakt on his behalf was Cho, with a cold tone.
"Shut up, introduce him briefly. Cho."
"Then, skipping a bit... He's the commander of our Kinzelo!"
It wasn't easy to read the intentions of the Jin faction this time.
Not only did they commit the terror, but revealing themselves openly was unexpected.
However, the highlight was the words that came out of Cho's mouth the next moment.
"We came to Geomhwang Castle with our ship Grunnel to rescue our deputy leader and his sister."
Crazy guys...
Swear words reflexively popped up in his mind.
'They committed the terror, and now they claim they came to save Bishkel and Margiella?'
It wasn't just that Jin couldn't read their intentions right away.
They were too blatant and simple. It was to the point where one wondered if they were actually calculating and acting.
'Did they instigate Bishkel and Margiella to get injured during the terror and use that as an excuse to claim they have nothing to do with the terror?'
Of course, it's an implausible story.
But on the other hand, it could have happened. It was a well-known fact that Bishkel was the most protective of his sister in the world.
Nobody would have thought that Bishkel would go so far as to use his sister's safety to commit such a terror.
Above all, there was no evidence.

Although the ship Grunnel manipulated lightning through magical power, there was not a single perfect means to prove that the Myeongin, bio-golems, and demons belonged to Kinzelo, excluding the circumstantial evidence.
'Maybe, Ron thinks that there's nothing to refute their guilt based on circumstantial evidence alone. They're completely underestimating Hairan.'
Was this their plan from the beginning?
At the sudden question, Jin quickly concluded that it wasn't.
'They probably intended to retreat after doing just enough. But because I rescued Veradin, their plan hit a snag.'
If Veradin had gone back like this, it would have been difficult for Hairan and Zefl's hostile relationship to be established.
Rather, since Jin rescued Veradin as Ron's special mission, there was no reason to be hostile.
The only reason they revealed themselves despite the failure of their plan was clear.

'Kinzelo seems determined to strike a severe blow to Hairan somehow. Since they lost the pretext to create a hostile relationship with Zefl, it feels like they're trying to trample on Hairan directly.'
Otherwise, there would be no reason for Belakt and Cho to appear and irritate Ron like this.
Belakt and Cho's actions were no different from challenging Ron to a fight.
"Hehehe."
Ron let out a hollow laugh again.
"Even the emperor speaks directly to me when talking. Moreover... I never thought I would look up to someone in this Geomhwang Castle. Come down, beast-man."
Then, Belakt chuckled.
"What if I don't want to, human Geomhwang?"
"I'll make you come down."
Ron did not ask Belakt and Cho for any other explanations of the situation. Why they attacked Geomhwang Castle and what kind of scheme this was.
That was something to ask when there was room for conversation. Ron had also made up his mind. To go to war with Kinzelo.
'It's playing into their hands. Ron must know that.'
Nevertheless, he could not back down. The moment Ron's Hairan retreated while Kinzelo had come out like this, his reputation would never be restored.
From the moment the ship Grunnel appeared, everyone present had the same suspicion about Kinzelo.
Rashid's blade was shining.
"I'll give you one warning. Come down immediately and show respect."
"I clearly told you my purpose. Hand over the new recruits of Kinzelo's deputy leader and his sister."
"It seems their lives aren't that precious to you."
The sword spirit aimed at the ship emitted a fierce aura.
The area was momentarily filled with a blinding light from the sword qi Ron shot.
The ship Grunnel looked as if it was completely buried in the sword qi, like sinking in the sea.
Everyone held their breath and waited for the light to disappear. Even though the ship Grunnel was a decisive weapon on par with Cozec, it seemed unlikely to be unscathed after that sword qi.
It was a sincere strike.
The sword qi of a 10-star knight, even from Ron Hairan, was surprisingly unable to cause even a scratch on the ship Grunnel.
Ron Hairan's pupils shook slightly.
Grunnel still floated in the air, just as it had appeared.
"If you really want to fight me, how about just the two of us move to a different location, human Geomhwang Ron Hairan? If you and I fight here, not a single one of your subordinates will survive."
